title: The Orchard of Valparaíso
author: Orsen Thornbury
blurb: Mirabel Eastwick, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
